intro: The Hallowed Sigil is an inscribed night elf token carried by young initiates within Shadowglen. Sent by the priest trainer Shanda, it serves as a formal summons directing prospective servants of Elune to the ancient boughs of Aldrassil.

p: Novice night elf priests stepping into the sacred canopy of Shadowglen often receive the Hallowed Sigil from a woodland messenger. Engraved with holy markings, the token acts as a personal writ from Shanda, the resident priest trainer at Aldrassil. Carrying and reading the sigil directs an acolyte upward to the towering hollow of Aldrassil, formally introducing them to the Sisterhood of Elune and initiating their spiritual service to the Kaldorei as new travelers arrive across Teldrassil.
